verdict.rationale: Rev AI is a speech-to-text API: it handles async and streaming transcription, adds features such as custom vocabulary, and sends webhook notifications. It has no automation or workflow layer, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships automation definitions that could be versioned.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
